entries.what: Arjun catches the new 6:48 a.m. Tule Line from Flats Junction after the 7:02 kept running late, grabbing his large masala chai from Anh's cart first.
entries.outcome: Makes it to campus early for his MWF classes.

entries.what: Classes 9-12 at Bayshore State, then a front desk shift at the career center.
entries.outcome: Finishes a few more application entries during slow desk time.

entries.what: Back at Marisol Gardens, Arjun passes Marcus heading out for his overtime-heavy Ridgeline night and leaves rajma in the fridge for him.
entries.outcome: Marcus is tired about the new ten-hour shifts; Arjun lets it go.

entries.what: Tweaks his resume until 1:30 a.m.
entries.outcome: Goes to bed late again.

entries.what: Rides the 6:48 train and attends operations management with Dr. Ashby at 10:30.
entries.outcome: Takes notes, no chance to talk about the letter.

entries.what: Before his Kestrel phone screen, he asks the assistant for a list of likely questions but says he'll just read them and skips practicing aloud.
entries.outcome: Gets a question list and no spoken rehearsal.

entries.what: Evening at the apartment updating the spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Adds more rows.

entries.what: Morning train and MWF classes, then a desk shift at the career center where Lena's mock-interview sign-up sheet sits in front of him.
entries.outcome: Pushes the mock interview off again.

entries.what: Skips the city council candidate forum at the community center despite Measure K talk, choosing to prep for Kestrel.
entries.outcome: Reads notes on Kestrel instead.

entries.what: Late-night run-through of the Kestrel notes in silence.
entries.outcome: Sleeps around 2 a.m.

entries.what: Takes the Kestrel Cold Chain phone screen between classes and blanks on 'tell me about yourself'.
entries.outcome: Call ends early and is clearly rough.

entries.what: Gets the Kestrel rejection email, jokes to the assistant that he's been freed from Kestrel, asks for a thank-you note, then wants to redo his resume instead of rehearsing.
entries.outcome: Sends the thank-you and plans a resume rebuild.

entries.what: Thursday office-hours window with Dr. Ashby passes; he does laundry on the card-only machines at night.
entries.outcome: Doesn't get to the letter talk.

entries.what: Rides the 6:48 and works a front desk shift at the career center.
entries.outcome: Quiet day.

entries.what: Asks the assistant how many applications normal people send before an offer, still stinging from Omar's internship posts.
entries.outcome: Gets a rough range and feels slightly better.

entries.what: Evening at the apartment with Marcus before his shift.
entries.outcome: Trades small talk over dinner.

entries.what: Saturday run on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop.
entries.outcome: Clears his head.

entries.what: Rebuilds his resume into v19, one page with a quantified warehouse-sim project.
entries.outcome: v19 done and saved.

entries.what: Sends v19 to a few targets and updates the spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Several new applications go out.

entries.what: Sunday dinner at his parents' Pell Road house; leaves with a tub of dal.
entries.outcome: Manpreet's Sunday call topics covered in person.

entries.what: Meal-preps rajma and rice and looks up how to split groceries so Marcus pays less this tight month.
entries.outcome: Plans to quietly cover more of the groceries.

entries.what: Helps Sunita's wedding vendor sheet for a bit before bed.
entries.outcome: Adds a few rows.

new_facts.value: sent a thank-you email to the Kestrel recruiter after the rejection

new_facts.subject: arjun
new_facts.value: plans to cover a bit more of the shared groceries so Marcus pays less

new_facts.subject: arjun
new_facts.value: spent about five hours rebuilding the resume on Saturday

new_facts.value: Marcus's Ridgeline nights got longer with the new overtime
